# Pre-existing component disclosure — proposed text

Status: PARTIAL; owner must confirm the final Track 3/submission-form requirements before use.

DecisionProof Agent consumes Agentic Intent Gate, an MIT-licensed open-source Python dependency developed before the competition by this entrant. The dependency is `agentic-intent-gate==0.2.0`, Git release `v0.2.0`, fixed commit `7261fdd2f47d2b15fabe8faac527eeee37338eb1`, public repository https://github.com/miku-wwl/agentic-intent-gate. MIT attribution/license is retained with distribution.

Reused capabilities include structured Plan validation, persistent Runs, exact Approval binding, separate execution Authorization, single-tool/single-step execution, durable claim/audit, stable effect identity, bounded adapters and fail-closed Unknown handling. These are not claimed as newly built competition work. No v0.3 code, copied Runtime implementation or modified core is used.

P0 research, environment/lock preparation, synthetic dependency checks and design reports were prepared before kickoff. At P0 there is no competition application implementation. The in-window product contribution, to be filled in after actual work, will identify new Zetaris retrieval, genuine Nemotron decision reasoning through the approved route, product UI/authentication, narrow sandbox task adapter, verification/tests and demo artifacts with dated evidence.

Before submission replace future-tense claims with exact implemented files, sponsor evidence and the authorized submission candidate hash. Include meaningful Cursor work separately. Do not describe the upstream release's test counts as this product's test results. Final eligibility remains subject to organizer rules and any required disclosure of entrant-authored pre-existing infrastructure.
